summary: Ready Capital Corp filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 reporting that its subsidiary ReadyCap Holdings II, LLC priced a private placement of $225.0 million aggregate principal amount of 10.00% Senior Secured Notes due 2031. The notes were sold under a note purchase agreement expected to close September 28, 2026, to institutional accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D, with UMB Bank, N.A. as collateral agent. The notes are guaranteed by the Company and four subsidiaries and secured by a first-priority lien on specified equity interests and Issuer assets. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch refinancing/leverage implications.
